title: Coverage changes the care-foregoing route without eliminating concurrent medical debt

observations.period: 2025; insured respondents with any cost-related care foregoing
observations.method: Any Yes among E1_a-E1_e and any Yes among E4_a-E4_f define care foregoing and insured status; outcomes use single-year weight.
observations.uncertainty: Same-respondent cross-sectional comparison; no replicate-weight standard errors, causal direction, or exact bill timing.
observations.subgroup: Insured respondents reporting any listed care type skipped because of cost.
observations.counterinterpretation: Coverage, plan design, illness, utilization, and selection into unexpected expense remain entangled.

observations.period: 2025; insured respondents with no listed cost-related care foregoing
observations.method: Any Yes among E4_a-E4_f defines insured status; all E1_a-E1_e=No defines no listed care foregoing; outcomes use single-year weight.
observations.uncertainty: Same-respondent cross-sectional comparison; no replicate-weight standard errors, causal direction, or exact bill timing.
observations.subgroup: Insured respondents reporting no listed care type skipped because of cost.
observations.counterinterpretation: No reported foregoing does not prove no unmet need or affordability; coverage does not identify plan generosity or access.

observations.period: 2025; uninsured respondents with any cost-related care foregoing
observations.method: All E4_a-E4_f=No defines uninsured status; any Yes among E1_a-E1_e defines care foregoing; outcomes use single-year weight.
observations.uncertainty: Same-respondent cross-sectional comparison; no replicate-weight standard errors, causal direction, or exact bill timing.
observations.subgroup: Uninsured respondents reporting any listed care type skipped because of cost.
observations.counterinterpretation: The uninsured group may differ in illness, age, care seeking, access, income, and family support; the expense may be unrelated to skipped care.

observations.period: 2025; uninsured respondents with no listed cost-related care foregoing
observations.method: All E4_a-E4_f=No defines uninsured status; all E1_a-E1_e=No defines no listed care foregoing; outcomes use single-year weight.
observations.uncertainty: Same-respondent cross-sectional comparison; no replicate-weight standard errors, causal direction, or exact bill timing.
observations.subgroup: Uninsured respondents reporting no listed care type skipped because of cost.
observations.counterinterpretation: No reported foregoing does not prove no unmet need, affordability, or absence of other financial pressure.

boundary: Coverage-conditioned same-respondent associations do not establish insurance effects, bill timing, clinical outcome, treatment alternative, institutional remedy, trust, or political action.
